name: camayoc_dora_change_reviews
description: DORA lead time review step (aegis-rb3): every review of each change merged in the window, with its time and verdict, from aegis:ChangeEvent. The reader takes the first review at or after the change's first green from camayoc_dora_change_steps; a change with no row had no recorded review. Only reviews at or before the merge are lifecycle steps. Graph scope: camayoc window graphs, plus the one staged backfill graph named by {staging}; no other named graph is read.
template: PREFIX aegis: <http://aegis.gastown.local/ontology/> SELECT ?change ?reviewedAt ?state WHERE { GRAPH ?gm { ?m a aegis:ChangeEvent ; aegis:changeId ?change ; aegis:changeRepository "{repository}" ; aegis:changeAction "merged" ; aegis:occurredAt ?mergedAt . } FILTER((STRSTARTS(STR(?gm), "https://camayoc.local/window/") || ?gm = <{staging}>) && STR(?mergedAt) >= "{start}" && STR(?mergedAt) < "{end}") GRAPH ?gr { ?r a aegis:ChangeEvent ; aegis:changeId ?change ; aegis:changeAction "reviewed" ; aegis:occurredAt ?reviewedAt . OPTIONAL { ?r aegis:reviewState ?state } } FILTER((STRSTARTS(STR(?gr), "https://camayoc.local/window/") || ?gr = <{staging}>) && STR(?reviewedAt) <= STR(?mergedAt)) } ORDER BY ?change ?reviewedAt

params.name: repository
params.description: change repository as owner/repo, e.g. scbrown/quipu

params.name: staging
params.description: exact IRI of the one reviewed staged-backfill graph read alongside the window graphs (aegis-rb3 B2); pass an IRI with no data, e.g. urn:quipu:import:staging:none, when there is none
